name: Diagnostyka S.A.
summary: Diagnostyka S.A. provides diagnostic services in Poland. The company operates as a medical laboratory, which offers services, such as ultrasound, X-ray, computed tomography, and magnetic resonance imaging. It also offers specialized research in the field of microbiology, autoimmunity, toxicology, and molecular biology, as well as human genome research, histopathological examinations, immunohistochemical tests, cytological tests, and cytogenetic tests. The company provides services to individual clients, and public and private entities. Diagnostyka S.A. was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in Kraków, Poland.
